summary: The filing is a Form 8-K (Item 8.01 Other Events) by GS Mortgage Securities Corporation II, as depositor for Benchmark 2024-V6 Mortgage Trust, reporting a routine servicing change. The special servicer for the 369 Lexington Avenue / 2 West 46th Street mortgage loan (~2.0% of the asset pool) was removed, and CWCapital Asset Management was appointed successor special servicer under the existing BMO 2023-5C2 pooling and servicing agreement. No merger, acquisition, tender, or other special situation is described—it is an administrative update. No deal terms apply.
